LITERATURE IN ENGLISH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: LITERATURE IN ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

1. D — One main idea with supporting sentences

2. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Literature 2.1.1 Oral Narratives: Introduction - Definition - Features - Ty.

3. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Fiction and Non - Fiction 2.3.1 Fiction: Novel from Kenya - Characters - Charact.

11. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Fiction and Non- Fiction 1.3.1 Fiction: Novel from Kenya - Features of prose fic.

12. A — went
